title: Adobe Experience Manager is affected by a DOM-based Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability. (CVE-2026-118481)
description: Adobe Experience Manager is affected by a DOM-based Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability that allows attackers to execute malicious JavaScript in the victim's browser by manipulating the DOM environment. Exploitation requires user interaction, specifically the victim visiting a crafted webpage. The vulnerability impacts confidentiality and integrity with a medium severity rating.
